meta.template_name: Batch Prompt Template Analysis and Transformation
meta.use_case: Analyzing multiple images/documents containing prompt templates and transforming them into structured, usable formats

task_definition.primary_objective: Analyze provided images/documents containing prompt templates and transform them into a specified output format
task_definition.deliverable_type: Structured prompt templates using RTCFR methodology (Role, Task, Context, Few-shots, Report/Tone)

input_specifications.content_description: Each image contains 1-5 prompt templates with template names, structure, and examples
input_specifications.source_location: Uploaded attachments in current conversation thread

extraction_requirements.handle_unclear_text: Acknowledge uncertainty in analysis notes rather than guessing

R_Role.description: Define who the AI should become (expertise, perspective, authority)
requirements: Specific professional title or expertise area
Years of experience (if relevant to credibility)
R_Role.example: You are a senior software engineer with 15 years of experience in algorithm design and code documentation best practices.

T_Task.description: Specify exactly what needs to be accomplished
requirements: Clear action verb (write, create, analyze, solve, etc.)
T_Task.example: Write a Python function to calculate Fibonacci numbers that includes proper error handling, clear documentation, and efficient implementation.

C_Context.description: Provide background, constraints, and situational information
C_Context.example: I'm building a math education application for middle school students. The function will be used by other developers, so code quality and documentation are critical. Performance matters since it might be called frequently.

F_FewShots.description: Provide examples showing desired patterns, quality, or format
requirements: 1-3 concrete examples showing good vs. bad
F_FewShots.example_structure:
Good example: [show effective approach]
Poor example: [show what to avoid]
Why the good example works: [explanation]

R_ReportTone.description: Specify output format, style, tone, and presentation requirements
requirements: Format (essay, bullet points, table, code, etc.)
Length constraints (word count, number of items)
R_ReportTone.example: Professional and well-documented. Include comprehensive docstring, inline comments, example usage. Use Google-style documentation format. Keep total function under 50 lines.

main_sections: Category header (## A. Basic Prompt Templates)
Template number and name (### 1. General Inquiry)
RTCFR formatted prompt in code block
structure.template_structure: Each template presented as complete, copy-paste ready RTCFR prompt inside markdown code block

quality_standards.accuracy: Templates must reflect original intent from source images
quality_standards.usability: Each prompt should be copy-paste ready without modification
quality_standards.consistency: All prompts follow identical RTCFR structure
quality_standards.human_readability: Written as if a professional prompt engineer created them
quality_standards.topic_selection: Choose realistic, practical topics for examples (not generic placeholders)

special_instructions.iteration_requirement: Provide complete output in ONE response - do not split into multiple messages
special_instructions.error_handling: If image is unreadable, note it but continue processing remaining images
topic_selection_for_examples: Choose topics that demonstrate the template's practical use
Vary topics across templates to show versatility
Make examples relevant to professional or educational contexts
special_instructions.tone_of_prompts: Write as professional prompt engineer would - natural, clear, human-sounding

primary_metrics: Each template follows complete RTCFR structure
Prompts are copy-paste ready without edits
Examples use realistic topics, not placeholders
quality_checks: Role clearly defines expertise and perspective
Few-shots include both good and bad examples
Report/Tone specifies format and style clearly
success_criteria.user_satisfaction: User can immediately copy any prompt and use it successfully with an AI system

how_to_use_this_template: 2. Modify the 'input_specifications' section with your specific files/content
3. Adjust 'task_definition' for your particular use case
4. Update 'output_specifications' if you need different formatting
5. Paste into AI chat with your files attached
6. AI will process everything in one iteration following this exact structure

customization_points.framework: Can change from RTCFR to CREATE, PREP, or custom framework
customization_points.output_format: Change to JSON, CSV, table, slides, etc.

execution_command.instruction_to_ai: Process all attached images according to this JSON specification. Extract prompt templates from images, transform each into RTCFR format with realistic example topics, and deliver all 50 templates in a single comprehensive response formatted in Markdown. Ensure each prompt is complete, professional, and immediately usable without further editing.
